title: Finite refinements of blow-ups
statement:
Let $T$ be qcqs and $U\subseteq T$ a quasi-compact open. Finitely many
$U$-admissible blow-ups of $T$ ([sk-def-nagata-admissible]) admit a common
$U$-admissible blow-up. A composite of two $U$-admissible blow-ups is again
such a blow-up. A $U$-admissible blow-up on a quasi-compact open
$V\subseteq T$ containing $U$ extends to a $U$-admissible blow-up of $T$.

proof.text:
For ideals $\mathcal I,\mathcal J$, blowing up their product factors through
both blow-ups. Indeed, after the product becomes an invertible ideal, each
factor is invertible, and the universal property applies. More explicitly,
first blowing up $\mathcal I$ and then the pulled-back $\mathcal J$ gives the
blow-up of $\mathcal I\mathcal J$ (Stacks 080A). Induction proves the first
assertion. For a center on the first blow-up which is not itself pulled back
from $T$, the composition assertion is the finite-type ideal calculation in
Stacks 080B.

The extension assertion uses extension of finite-type quasi-coherent ideals
from a quasi-compact open, with a center still outside $U$; the precise
admissible extension result is Stacks 080M. These two results turn finitely
many local constructions into one global modification preserving $U$.

lean.statement: theorem nagata_sketch_blowups {T : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T] {U : T.Opens} (hU : IsCompact (U : Set T)) : (∀ (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → IsAdmissible T U), ∃ (C : IsAdmissible T U) (m : ∀ i : Fin n, C.I.blowup ⟶ (B i).I.blowup), ∀ i : Fin n, m i ≫ (B i).I.blowupMap = C.I.blowupMap) ∧ (∀ (B₁ : IsAdmissible T U) (B₂ : IsAdmissible B₁.I.blowup (B₁.I.blowupMap ⁻¹ᵁ U)), ∃ (C : IsAdmissible T U) (e : B₂.I.blowup ≅ C.I.blowup), e.hom ≫ C.I.blowupMap = B₂.I.blowupMap ≫ B₁.I.blowupMap) ∧ (∀ (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set T)) (hUV : U ≤ V) (J : V.toScheme.IdealSheafData) (hJ : J.ofFiniteType) (hdisj : Disjoint ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U : V.toScheme.Opens) : Set V.toScheme) (J.support : Set V.toScheme)), ∃ (B : IsAdmissible T U) (h : J.blowup ⟶ B.I.blowup), h ≫ B.I.blowupMap = J.blowupMap ≫ V.ι ∧ IsPullback J.blowupMap h V.ι B.I.blowupMap)
